requirement_match.summary: Six Analytics E2E cases passed on Chromium and mobile, including blocked dependencies and no manual page_view command.

security.summary: No Analytics request occurs before consent; revocation prevents collection after reload.

code_quality.summary: Focused lint and TypeScript checks passed after the test correction.

failure_paths.summary: The site remains usable when Firebase, Installations, Tag Manager, and Analytics endpoints are blocked.

error_handling.summary: Dependency failures remain isolated from navigation and content.

production_readiness.summary: Full mobile regression found the fixed consent surface intercepted unrelated CTA and media interactions.

trade_offs.summary: The consent surface is intentionally non-modal and must not prevent use of the site.

findings.problem: The fixed mobile consent surface intercepted clicks on the primary CTA and product video.
findings.production_impact: Visitors could be unable to use core site actions until choosing an Analytics preference.
findings.correction: Make non-interactive banner regions pointer-transparent and reserve mobile scroll space while the banner is present.

limitations: Governed runtime review recorder is unavailable in this checkout; cycle is recorded in the approved proposal path.
